articles.summary: Century Communities' board on Nov 4, 2026 elected James Francescon president effective Jan 1, 2027, succeeding Robert J. Francescon, who stays CEO; James has overseen homebuilding, land, strategy and acquisitions.
articles.why_it_matters: The incoming president at the tenth-largest builder has run its land and acquisitions, so he is the person Domain should get in front of before he takes the seat in January.

suggested_update.text: James Francescon elected president effective Jan 1, 2027 (board vote Nov 4, 2026), succeeding Robert J. Francescon, who remains CEO.

articles.summary: Century Communities bought substantially all assets of HMH Lifestyles (HistoryMaker Homes), tripling its Dallas-Fort Worth community count; price undisclosed. HistoryMaker's sister firm Jabez Development will keep developing select lots for Century.
articles.why_it_matters: Century is absorbing a DFW lot pipeline and tying up a developer (Jabez) as its lot source, which tells Domain how Century is sourcing land in Texas and where option financing could slot in.

suggested_update.text: Acquired substantially all assets of HMH Lifestyles (HistoryMaker Homes) in Dallas-Fort Worth, reported Oct 8, 2026; price undisclosed.

articles.summary: HHHunt will make CFO Ann Kelly CEO on July 1, 2027; CEO Buck Hunt stays chairman. SVP of finance and treasury Steve Brant becomes CFO; COO Steve Fritz stays.
articles.why_it_matters: HHHunt's finance chief is moving up and its treasurer is taking the CFO seat, so the people who would sign a land-bank deal there are changing and worth a call.

suggested_update.text: CFO Ann Kelly becomes CEO July 1, 2027 and SVP finance and treasury Steve Brant becomes CFO; Buck Hunt remains chairman (announced Oct 2026).

articles.summary: Virginia Business reports HHHunt CEO Buck Hunt will step down July 1, 2027, with a named successor; same announcement as the HousingWire item.
articles.why_it_matters: Same HHHunt succession as the kept item; adds no new facts for Domain.

articles.summary: LGI Homes reported Q3 2026: net orders fell 61.2% to 609 and backlog to 685 homes. It owned 50,270 lots and controlled 8,130 at Sept 30; net debt-to-capital was 40.6% and liquidity $447.7M.
articles.why_it_matters: LGI owns most of its lots while orders collapse and its controlled count grows, so it is a candidate for land-light capital Domain could offer.

suggested_update.text: At Sept 30, 2026: 50,270 owned and 8,130 controlled lots, net debt-to-capital 40.6%, liquidity $447.7M (Q3 2026 results, Nov 3, 2026).

articles.summary: HousingWire analysis of LGI's Q3 2026: revenue and gross margin up, but orders fell 61.2% and cancellations rose to 53.8%. Owned lots have fallen six straight quarters to 50,270.
articles.why_it_matters: Same LGI quarter as the kept release. It adds that owned lots have fallen six straight quarters while controlled lots rose 18.1%, a move toward the option structures Domain finances.

articles.summary: Mattamy Homes is buying 59 lots at Legacy Place in Glendale, Ariz., for $10.62M, its debut there. The headline says K. Hovnanian exited smaller parcels; homes priced $445,900 to $526,900.
articles.why_it_matters: A K. Hovnanian exit from Phoenix parcels may be a land-position change at a named Domain relationship worth asking about (paywalled; details unconfirmed).

articles.summary: Taylor Morrison bought 406 lots in Peoria, Ariz., near TSMC's Phoenix chip development, per the Phoenix Business Journal (paywalled; terms not confirmed).
articles.why_it_matters: A 406-lot purchase by a top-ten builder shows Taylor Morrison still buying sizeable Phoenix positions, which could be financed off balance sheet.

articles.summary: At HousingWire's Homebuilder Summit, Toll Brothers' Rob Paul and Dustin Bowersett said Toll scores land on gross margin and IRR. Land sellers hold price but give on timing and takedown schedules.
articles.why_it_matters: Sellers giving on takedown schedules rather than price is a direct read on the option terms Domain competes with, from a top-ten builder.

articles.summary: Mattamy Homes closed on 71 finished homesites in La Estancia, East Tucson, on Oct 29, 2026, and plans to open a new community there.
articles.why_it_matters: A small finished-lot buy showing Mattamy expanding in Arizona; a minor read on its land appetite.

articles.summary: Ashton Woods' fiscal Q1 2027: net orders down 6.7%, cancellations 24.9%, gross margin 22.7% versus 25.0%. Management called land the main margin pressure and said it underwrites to today's pricing.
articles.why_it_matters: Ashton Woods is cutting new land commitments while land sellers are slow to reprice, which points to slower option demand from a top-15 builder.

articles.summary: Green Brick Partners reported its third-quarter 2026 results on Oct 28, 2026 (release not opened; figures not confirmed).
articles.why_it_matters: Green Brick self-develops most of its lots, so its quarter matters to Domain mainly as a read on whether it is changing that land-heavy model.

articles.summary: KB Home named company veteran Casey Dare president of its Tampa division as four new communities prepare to open there.
articles.why_it_matters: A division president approves local land deals, so this is a regional KB Home contact for Domain in Tampa, not a corporate change.

articles.summary: loanDepot and Davidson Homes formed Davidson Mortgage, a joint venture offering mortgages to Davidson buyers in six states, announced Nov 10, 2026.
articles.why_it_matters: A buyer-mortgage JV adds no land or builder-level funding, so it barely touches Domain's business with Davidson.

suggested_update.text: Formed Davidson Mortgage, a mortgage JV with loanDepot covering six states, announced Nov 10, 2026.

articles.summary: DRB Group announced two mortgage joint ventures on Sept 23, 2026: Acrisure Mortgage for its eastern markets and Alta Home Lending for the west.
articles.why_it_matters: Buyer-mortgage JVs do not change DRB's land or builder-level funding, so there is little here for Domain.

articles.why_it_matters: A sales hire, not a land or finance role, so it does not change who Domain deals with at Ashton Woods.
